title: Where, O Death, Is Your Victory

request.style: English, Salvation Army Easter march, full brass band with cornets in front, bass drum and cymbals, an open-air crowd singing in unison and shouting hallelujah, bold and triumphant, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Listen, I tell you a mystery
We shall not all sleep
In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye
At the last trumpet we shall all be changed

[Chorus]
Death is swallowed up in victory
Where, O death, is your victory
Where, O death, is your sting
Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory

[Verse]
For the trumpet will sound
And the dead will be raised
This mortal body puts on immortality
Hallelujah, the grave has lost its prey

[Chorus]
Death is swallowed up in victory
Where, O death, is your victory
Where, O death, is your sting
Thanks be to God, who gives us the victory
